dialect.detail: IBM CICS/TS online program; uses DFHCOMMAREA and EXEC CICS commands typical of IBM mainframe CICS environment; invokes ALNSCORE which appears to be an IBM Analytics (Watson/SnapML) scoring service

purpose.domain_detail: Credit card fraud detection using a machine learning model (SnapML) invoked via CICS containers
purpose.summary: This CICS online program submits transaction data (amount, merchant city/name/state, user) to an IBM Analytics SnapML scoring service (ALNSCORE) via CICS channels and containers. It passes a model UUID and input/output class names, then retrieves and displays fraud prediction probabilities. It acts as a CICS front-end to an ML-based fraud scoring engine.

notable_features: EXEC CICS PUT CONTAINER / GET CONTAINER (CICS channel/container API)
EXEC CICS LINK to ALNSCORE (IBM SnapML scoring program)
DFHCOMMAREA with COPY MODELIN / COPY MODELOUT copybooks
UUID-style MODEL_ID value suggesting IBM Analytics deployment
SnapMLIN / SnapMLOUT class names indicating IBM SnapML integration
verdict.notes: Short program (62 lines) but clearly production-oriented; uses IBM CICS channel/container API and references a specific ML model UUID. Some DISPLAY and PERFORM statements are commented out, suggesting iterative development. The two COPY statements (MODELIN, MODELOUT) are not shown but are required for full compilation.
